name: teenwork
description: Платформа подработки и разовых заданий для подростков 14-18 лет

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @teenwork/shared && npm run build -w @teenwork/db
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @teenwork/api && npm run build -w @teenwork/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @teenwork/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @teenwork/api && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist apps/*/.next apps/api/dist
